deltas.title_id: Peraturan Direktur Jenderal Pajak Nomor PER-6/PJ/2026 tentang kewajiban registrasi Wajib Pajak GloBE
deltas.title_en: Directorate General of Taxes Regulation PER-6/PJ/2026 on mandatory GloBE taxpayer registration
deltas.impact_note: MNE groups meeting the GloBE EUR 750M threshold must self-register constituent entities via Coretax (Portal Saya) by 2026-09-30 or the tax office adds the status administratively.
deltas.summary: Multinational enterprise groups meeting the GloBE (Pillar Two) threshold for their first GloBE assessment year 2025 must register as GloBE taxpayers through Coretax before month-end; the statutory deadline is 9 months after the close of the first GloBE tax year.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Permohonan penambahan status sebagai wajib pajak GloBE disampaikan paling lambat 9 bulan setelah berakhirnya tahun pengenaan GloBE pertama pada saat grup PMN memenuhi ketentuan

deltas.title_id: Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 49 Tahun 2026 tentang Sistem Pemungutan PPN atas Transaksi Digital Luar Negeri (SPP-TDLN)
deltas.title_en: Minister of Finance Regulation No. 49/2026 on the VAT Collection System for Cross-Border Digital Transactions (SPP-TDLN)
deltas.impact_note: Foreign digital merchants/service providers selling to Indonesian customers must embed Indonesian PPN in price and route collection through a designated payment intermediary under SPP-TDLN, effective 2026-09-25.
deltas.summary: DJP officially implemented SPP-TDLN: foreign merchants must include PPN in the price charged to Indonesian customers, PPN is collected via a designated payment intermediary or other specified party, and the amount remitted to the foreign merchant is net of the PPN collected.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Di bawah SPP-TDLN, pedagang dan penyedia jasa asing wajib memasukkan PPN Indonesia ke dalam harga atau jumlah total yang harus dibayar oleh pelanggan di Indonesia
